notes: IO-Link characterization centers on the C/Q line switching/UART levels, the wake-up request and SIO<->SDCI transition, the COM-rate bit timing (COM1/COM2/COM3) and 8-E-1 framing, the M-sequence CKT/CKS checksums, the Process Data cycle time vs MinCycleTime, the ISDU parameter access, and Event reporting. Conformance is established by IO-Link / IEC 61131-9 (SDCI) compliance testing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: C/Q signal levels
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the push-pull 0 V / 24 V switching and UART levels on the C/Q line.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Wake-up request
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the wake-up pulse switches the Device from SIO to SDCI mode.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: COM rate / bit timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm COM1 = 4.8 kbaud, COM2 = 38.4 kbaud, COM3 = 230.4 kbaud and the 8-E-1 bit timing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: M-sequence / checksum
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the Master message + Device response framing and the CKT/CKS checksums.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Process Data cycle time
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm cyclic exchange respects the Device's MinCycleTime.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: ISDU access
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm Index/Subindex parameter read/write and segmentation.
